meta.title: Auction Time Controls: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and compare refusal or absence for extending, shortening, and ending submission time against a Buyer on the same tenant
Verify shortening submission time with a logged reason
Verify the tenant's actual RBAC configuration or whether it deliberately grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and compare refusal or absence for extending, shortening, and ending submission time against a Buyer on the same tenant; Verify shortening submission time with a logged reason; Verify the tenant's actual RBAC configuration or whether it deliberately grants the action to additional roles

steps.note: Open an existing suitable auction event so the time-control actions can be assessed without creating a different subject.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then the Buyer on the same Growth tenant, attempt extending, shortening, and ending auction submission with a logged reason in both roles, and report whether each action is refused, absent, or succeeds

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and the complete cross-role comparison are not expressible by catalog steps.
Confirm the final Buyer-facing event state offers the available submission-time and end controls.
